_what: How the creative strategist's swipe step searches the paid library. Brand-agnostic: nothing here names a brand. A brand overrides a field by declaring it in its own folder (brands/<brand>/strategy/markets.json for markets); keywords and categories are never set here, they come from the avatar.

signal.sort: grouped_new_ads_desc — new copies in the last 7 days (velocity)

keywords: from the avatar's own words: machine/keywords.py --brand <b> --avatar <a> [--sub <s>]
categories: the product's own category + the avatar's affinity groups (profile)
credits: 1 per ad returned + 1 per call; count is the price. Plan + cost shown and approved before any pull. Review already-paid results first.
